Name: (RETIRED) Void's weird Wonders - Bachelor(ette)s as Goths
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[b][size=3][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still TECHNICALLY works in 1.6. The newly added winter sprites are mission though and the Format needs to be changed in the content.json. It will not be updated further though.[/i][/size][/b]

This time I bring you all the bachelors and bachelorettes as different subtypes of Goths! I tried making each one unique, not repeating any subtype, so I hope it's visible what I wanted to convey.

Abigail is a [i]Casual Goth[/i], Alex is a [i]Rivethead[/i], Elliott is a [i]Romantic Goth[/i], Emily is a [i]Hippie Goth[/i], Haley is a [i]Carnival Goth[/i], Harvey is a [i]Corporate Goth[/i], Leah is [i]Dark Mori[/i](debatable Goth but it fits her), Maru is a [i]Cybergoth[/i], Penny is [i]Pastel Goth[/i], Sam is [i]Glam Goth[/i], Sebastian is [i]Trad Goth[/i] and Shane is an [i]Emo[/i](who accidentally ended up kinda looking like Onision but shhh).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
